description: This file contains a set of functions responsible for setting up and rendering a 3D scene using a graphics library, including shapes like sphere, cylinder, box, and torus, along with camera control and drawing routines.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the window with specified dimensions and rendering mode, and sets the frame rate.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Renders the 3D scene, including background, camera control, text, and various geometric shapes with transformations.
